instagram.justification: The draft captures core insights accurately with engaging visual carousel cues and meets all format constraints including hashtags.

flyer.justification: The flyer adheres to the 6-word title limit, utilizes high-impact lines, and correctly uses TBA placeholders for event logistics.

summary.justification: The executive briefing is well under the 400-word limit, well-structured in Markdown with TL;DR, evidence, discussion points, and action items.

linkedin.justification: The post has strong storytelling and avoids forbidden buzzwords, but fails to include the required 3-5 hashtags.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter follows all editorial requirements, features a subject line under 50 characters, and includes three distinct sections with bold subheadings.

blog.justification: The blog post thoroughly expands on the talk's themes with numbered sections, a structured takeaway table, and an About the Author section.
